verdict.rationale: Runpod has a public pricing page at runpod.io/pricing advertising simple plans across thousands of GPUs, plus pricing docs describing per-second billing for Pods and Serverless and commitment discounts. Self-serve credit-based billing means no sales contact is needed. However, the evidence never shows actual per-GPU-hour rates listed for each GPU type. Missing for 10: evidence of explicit published per-GPU-hour prices covering every GPU type, independent corroboration that the page lists full rates without sales contact.
